contexts.text: The proprium is called the rib built into a woman. ().
The rib, which is a bone of the breast, = the proprium of man, in which there is little vital, and, in fact, a proprium which is clear to him. AC 148.
The rib = the proprium not vivified; built into a woman = the proprium vivified by the Lord.

Upon the two ribs thereof () = conjunction with truths on the one side, and conservation thereby... Ribs, when they mean the sides, = truths; for the sides, which are called ribs, look towards the south and north...
Moreover the ribs, being the supports of the breast, = the truths which support good.
Three ribs between its teeth () = appearances and fallacies.

That a woman is actually formed into a wife according to (the statement) that the woman was created out of the man's rib... By a rib of the breast, in the Word, is signified natural truth. This is signified by the ribs which the bear held between its teeth... The man's breast = ... wisdom; and truth supports wisdom as a rib the breast. (Thus) the woman was created from the man by a transcription of his proper wisdom, which is from natural truth; and the love of this was transferred into the woman, in order to become conjugial love. (Further explained.)
The ribs first cooperate with the lungs, and then afterwards the lungs with the ribs; hence the respiration of every membrane in the body... (See DLW 403:2. DLW 408.)
(These Spirits) are permitted no higher than the higher ribs.
(These Angels, who resuscitate those spiritually dead) are the ribs.
While thinking of the meaning of the word rib out of which the woman was built...
(Those in a holy external) operated into the lower ribs of the left side...
Three ribs () = all things of the Word...
Three ribs in the mouth between the teeth = Knowledges of truth from the Word in abundance which are perverted by reasonings from fallacies.
